name: Vexa
description: Self-hosted meeting bots that join Google Meet, Teams and Zoom calls, stream transcripts over an API and feed knowledge agents.
whatItDoes: Sends a bot into a video meeting on request and returns the transcript in real time for developers building meeting products or internal assistants. Agents can then answer questions over the collected meeting knowledge.
howItWorks: A set of services launches browser-based bots per meeting, transcribes audio and exposes transcripts through REST and websocket endpoints. Agents run in sandboxes with access to stored transcripts and are reached through a chat endpoint. The whole stack is built and started with a single make target.

requirements.name: Docker and make
requirements.description: The stack builds and runs in containers

requirements.name: Transcription and LLM services
requirements.description: Configured in the environment for transcripts and agent replies
